verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official MCP server whose tools let AI agents interact with the Stripe API, so a user can drive Stripe through natural language from an MCP-capable AI client. There is no native natural-language interface in the product itself, and nothing confirms the MCP tools cover Issuing operations such as cards, cardholders or spending controls. missing for 10: native natural-language command interface in the Dashboard or product, evidence that the MCP tools cover Issuing-specific operations, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe’s knowledge base
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
